system.description:
When you or a creature within your threatened area is targeted by a ranged weapon attack, you can attempt to redirect the weapon attack to another target within your threatened area. This functions like @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.wQ4Nfo1TleyI7xLC]{Redirected Power} but you must overcome the attackers’s combat maneuver DC. On a success, you are able to redirect all ranged attacks that target makes against valid targets this turn.

This ability can redirect thrown weapons, but not exceptionally large items such as catapult boulders or the thrown stones of giants.
